description: Retail Tower connector configuration (spec 006 — sales posting; spec 007 — credential lifecycle). The DP2 posting-feed endpoint + auth token, the operator-owned mapping tables (unit→UOM, store→warehouse, store→customer, tender→Mode of Payment) the scheduled poller reads each tick, and the registration-linked credential lifecycle (registration/credential refs + expiry) so the connector can warn before expiry instead of only reacting to a 401 (007 §5/§6), and the pollers' feed state (RT-883). The token is a secret (Password field, Gate G4 — never logged); the lifecycle ids/timestamps are non-secret status.

fields.label: DP2 Base URL
fields.description: Base URL of the Data-Pulse-2 connector API, e.g. https://dp2.example.com. The poller appends /api/connector/v1/erpnext/postings (spec 003).

fields.label: DP2 Connector Token
fields.description: The opaque connectorBearer token (spec 003). SECRET — stored encrypted, read via get_password, never logged (Gate G4). Sourced from the once-shown IssuedCredential.secret (007 §5, E-1); still hand-configured DP2-side, the connector only presents it.

fields.label: DP2 Connector Registration Id
fields.description: The connector_registration id the active credential is linked to (007 §5, E-3). NON-SECRET identifier — survives credential rotation (a rotate swaps the token/credential id/expiry but leaves this unchanged). Lets the DP2-side list/audit correlate this instance.

fields.label: DP2 Credential Id
fields.description: The auth_tokens credential id (IssuedCredential.credential_id, 007 §5, E-1). NON-SECRET — identifies WHICH credential is configured, for rotate/revoke correlation. Not the secret itself (that is dp2_token).

fields.label: DP2 Credential Issued At
fields.description: Provenance of the current credential (IssuedCredential issue time, 007 §5). NON-SECRET — audit/correlation.

fields.label: DP2 Credential Expires At
fields.description: The credential's bounded expiry (IssuedCredential.expires_at, server default 90 days, 007 §5/§6, E-1). NON-SECRET — drives the pre-expiry warning (G-2): the connector compares now() to this and surfaces 'credential expiring — request rotation' BEFORE a 401. The connector cannot self-rotate (admin surface is session-only).

fields.label: Credential Warn Days
fields.description: How many days before dp2_credential_expires_at the connector starts logging the 'credential expiring — request rotation' ops alert each poll tick (007 OQ-1a). NON-SECRET. Blank/0 → the 14-day default; a negative value is a config error (fail-loud).

fields.label: Unit → UOM Map
fields.description: Signed Option-A unit→ERPNext-UOM map (FR-008). An unmapped unit fails closed → validation.

fields.label: Store → Warehouse Map
fields.description: Store→ERPNext-Warehouse map applying the DP2-pre-resolved warehouse (FR-010, rider R5).

fields.label: Store → Customer Map
fields.description: Store→ERPNext-Customer map (F-009). The 012 work-item carries no customer; an unmapped store fails closed → validation. The connector never fabricates a customer (Principle VI).

fields.label: Tender → Mode of Payment Map
fields.description: RT-78 / RT-10 D5: maps each POS tender method to an ERPNext Mode of Payment (with a company account). A sale carrying tenders posts as a paid Sales Invoice; an unmapped method fails closed → validation. May stay empty while sales are tender-unknown (they post unpaid, as before).

fields.label: Posting Currency
fields.description: RT-379: the currency Retail Tower sales post in (ISO 4217). The poller checks it against the company currency and the ERPNext currency precision before every tick; blank pauses posting (critical, the backlog stays in Backend-Core).

fields.label: Compatibility Status
fields.description: RT-379 (read-only, written by the poller): OK, WARNING (posting continues) or CRITICAL (posting paused). It reflects the last profile run: a tick skipped earlier (the G5 index guard, or a missing token / URL / maps) leaves it unchanged, and Compatibility Checked At (checked_at) shows its age.

fields.label: Compatibility Fingerprint
fields.description: RT-379: sha256 of the ERPNext/Frappe versions and checked settings. A change is logged as compatibility.drift.

fields.label: Compatibility Report
fields.description: RT-379: the latest findings, one per line. The connector never changes ERP settings to pass (Pricing 668).

fields.label: Posting Feed Cursor
fields.description: RT-883 (read-only, written by the posting poller): the opaque posting-feed cursor, persisted so a cache flush does not replay the feed from the start. The cache stays the fast path.

fields.label: Bin-View Feed Cursor
fields.description: RT-883 (read-only, written by the bin-view poller): the opaque bin-view pull-request cursor.

fields.label: Bin-View Retry State
fields.description: RT-883 (read-only, written by the bin-view poller): the RT-176 retry set as JSON. Persisted with the cursor, which passes a failed request only once the retry set holds it.
